|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[General Veers (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-generalveers-2022-07-31.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-generalveers-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-generalveers-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-D-generalveers-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-generalveers-2022-07-31.png]], 31 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-generalveersab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/generalveers.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/generalveers.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
